instruction: Candid sports photograph, dynamic medium shot of a judo match on blue and yellow mats. In the foreground, the young woman in a blue judo gi (R1) stands with her back to the camera, crouching slightly. In the midground left, the young man in a white judo gi (R2) crouches low on the mat, looking up at her with a focused expression as they prepare to grapple. Bright indoor lighting casts soft shadows across the training area.
